title: Catch a wrong affects_skills format at cells add instead of at cap
action: Validate that every affects_skills entry is a repo-relative path under skills/ at cells add and cells update, refusing a bare skill name with the exact replacement path; name the format on the affects_skills help line; and make sync_refusal check (c) say so when an unfulfilled prediction is a bare name whose skills/<name>/SKILL.md exists.

truths: bee cells add refuses a cell whose affects_skills carries a bare skill name, names that entry, and names skills/<name>/SKILL.md as the replacement when that file exists.
bee cells update refuses the same wrong format, so a backfill cannot smuggle a name past the door.
A cell whose affects_skills entries are all paths under skills/ is still accepted exactly as before.
The affects_skills help line names the path format.
sync_refusal check (c) keeps its comparison, but names the resolved path when an unfulfilled prediction is a bare name with an existing skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
The whole-batch validation contract is unchanged: every bad entry is named in one call and nothing is written.

acceptance: A cell whose affects_skills carries a bare name is refused at add time, naming the entry and the skills/<name>/SKILL.md replacement; the same refusal covers cells update; the help line names the format; the cap-time refusal names the path when it sees a bare name; existing cells tests stay green.

trace.outcome: affects_skills format is refused at cells add/update with the exact skills/<name>/SKILL.md replacement; the sync door names a bare-name prediction as a format error
